name: Recovery Credentials
description: Recovery keys, recovery contacts, recovery codes. Multi-factor recovery with social verification option. Recovery is receipted and rate-limited.
purpose: Ensure accounts are recoverable when primary authentication is lost, without introducing a single point of compromise.
acceptanceCriteria: Recovery key generation: one-time use backup key, stored as hash, revealed to user once
Recovery contacts: trusted principals who can approve recovery request
Recovery codes: time-limited single-use codes for emergency access
Multi-factor recovery: requires 2 of 3 (recovery key, contact approval, email verification)
Social verification: N-of-M trusted contacts must approve recovery
Recovery flow is receipted: every attempt, success, and failure logged
Rate-limited: max N recovery attempts per time window per account
